lines.text: Ahaz became king at twenty, reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem, made images of the Baals, and sacrificed his sons in the fire.
The LORD delivered Ahaz to the king of Aram, who took captives to Nineveh, and Pekah killed 120,000 men of Judah.
Israelites took 200,000 captives to Samaria, but the prophet Oded told them to return the captives from Judah.
The armed men left the captives and plunder, and designated men clothed and fed the captives and brought them to Hebron.
Ahaz cut up the articles of God's house, shut the temple doors, and was not placed in the tombs of the kings.
